title: Critique: a functional account cannot solve the hard problem

statements.text: A referee objected that, since the argument rests on a kind of functionalism, a functional role defined by variational free energy, it cannot solve the hard problem, of which functionalism is a prime target. Solms and Friston concede that they offer only a scientific response to a metaphysical problem.

sources.quote: One of our referees notes that, to the extent that our argument rests on a type of functionalism
we concede that we can only provide a scientific response to the problem as quoted above
